test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The sides ST and TR and the median SU of the Δ STR are equal to the sides MN and NJ and the median MV of the Δ MNJ, respectively. If ∠TSU = 46°, ∠NMJ = 79°and ∠MVN = 88°, what is the degree measure of = (7)/(11)∠SRT?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since U and V are midpoints of TR and NJ, TR = NJ ⇒ TU = NV.

By SSS congruence, ΔSTU ≅ ΔMNV (ST = MN, SU = MV, TU = NV).

This gives ∠NMV = ∠TSU = 46° and ∠MNJ = 180° − (46° + 88°) = 46°.

In ΔMNJ, ∠MJN = 180° − (∠MNJ + ∠NMJ) = 180° − (46° + 79°) = 55°.

By SAS congruence, ΔSTR ≅ ΔMNJ ⇒ ∠SRT = ∠MJN = 55°.

Required measure = 7/11 × 55° = 35°.

**∴ The correct answer is 35°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Sides ST = MN

⇒ Side TR = NJ

⇒ Median SU = Median MV

⇒ ∠TSU = 46°, ∠NMJ = 79°, and ∠MVN = 88°

**Formula Used:**

⇒ SSS Congruence Rule: If three sides are equal, the triangles are congruent.

⇒ SAS Congruence Rule: If two sides and the included angle are equal, the triangles are congruent.

 
 
• S T R U 46° 
 
• M N J V 79° 88°

• ∴ ∠SRT = 55° 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since SU and MV are medians, U and V divide the bases TR and NJ into equal halves.

⇒ TR = NJ ⇒ TR/2 = NJ/2 ⇒ TU = NV

⇒ Consider ΔSTU and ΔMNV: ST = MN, SU = MV, and TU = NV.

⇒ By SSS congruence, ΔSTU ≅ ΔMNV.

⇒ This implies corresponding angles are equal: ∠NMV = ∠TSU = 46°, and ∠SUT = ∠MVN = 88°.

⇒ In ΔMNV, using angle sum property: ∠MNV = 180° − (46° + 88°) = 46°.

⇒ Angle ∠MNJ is the same as ∠MNV, hence ∠MNJ = 46°.

⇒ In the full ΔMNJ, angle sum property gives: ∠MJN = 180° − (∠MNJ + ∠NMJ) = 180° − (46° + 79°) = 55°.

⇒ Now compare ΔSTR and ΔMNJ: ST = MN, TR = NJ, and the included angles ∠STR = ∠MNJ (since ΔSTU ≅ ΔMNV).

⇒ By SAS congruence, ΔSTR ≅ ΔMNJ.

⇒ Therefore, corresponding angles are equal: ∠SRT = ∠MJN = 55°.

⇒ Required value = 7/11 × ∠SRT = 7/11 × 55° = 35°.

**∴ The correct answer is 35°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Congruence of Triangles (SSS and SAS)

Two triangles are identically congruent if all three corresponding sides are equal (SSS), or if two sides and the included angle are equal (SAS). Congruent triangles have exactly the same size and shape.

Median of a Triangle

A line segment joining a vertex to the exact midpoint of the opposite side. It cleanly divides the opposite side into two identical half-segments.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles in any planar triangle always equals 180°. This is a fundamental rule used repeatedly to find unknown missing angles.
